title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live! — Episode7 Wedding Concert ♡

meta.Event Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue
Show Stage

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, this crowd's huge!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It really is!
All the guests must be gathered here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm looking forward to the show. Kusanagi sounded pretty excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm not seeing Minori anywhere.
The show's about to start. Do you think she's still streaming?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I figured we'd find her right in the front row by the time the curtains went up.

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Thank you all for your patience.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <“The Happy Wedding Show” will begin shortly!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh no...
The show's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She might arrive right after it does.
For now, let's just watch while we wait.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds good...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “A wedding, huh...?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I guess I'm sort of interested. But I dunno...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “He didn't seem all that interested, either. Plus, if we do decide to hold one, it's going to be a lot of work and cost a lot of money...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “So, I really don't think it's worth the trouble.”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel A
rows.Line:
“Oh...?
Are you sure about that?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“Huh...?
Wh-Who are all of you...?”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel B
rows.Line:
“We're the wedding angels!
And we're here to tell you all about how great weddings are!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “W-Wedding angels...? What are you talking about...?”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel C
rows.Line:
“Heh heh heh.
We'll keep showing you the true fun of weddings until you're begging us to stop!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel D
rows.Line: “Hey, wouldn't that ruin them for her?”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Their costumes are incredible!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I kinda like the idea of angels wearing dresses and tuxedos. It feels like a fresh take.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it is a pretty good idea. It doubles as advertisement for the dresses...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, over there! Isn't that...?!

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Deciding not to have a wedding before you even know anything about them would be such a big shame!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hanasato?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
Is she a guest star or something?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I dunno...
But something must've happened to have her up there.

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's why we're gonna give you a tour of the wide world of weddings today!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Th-The wide world of weddings...?”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel A
rows.Line:
“Hehe. It'll be faster just to show you, so let's...!
Go!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “A-Are we aboard a train...?”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel A
rows.Line: “Our first stop is a train wedding, which involves renting out an actual train and holding a ceremony aboard it!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel A
rows.Line:
“Take a look outside the window.
This special view's meant just for you!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“Wow, it's so beautiful!
I feel like I'm on vacation...”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel B
rows.Line:
“Alright, it's my turn next!
Lemme show you a wedding in the great outdoors!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
This is how they're going to show off all these different types of weddings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, then... Does that mean Hanasato is going to do the same?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That still doesn't really explain why she's on stage, but I'm kinda looking forward to seeing her part now.

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Is this a campground?”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel B
rows.Line: “Yup. You'd be having your wedding outdoors, so you can have a big barbeque while wearing your dress!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“Really...?!
This is an actual option?!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel C
rows.Line:
“Hey, don't forget about me!
I've got an awesome aquarium wedding coming up for you next!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “The underwater tunnel acts as the aisle...!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel C
rows.Line:
“It gets even better!
Imagine having the dolphins do tricks while you kiss after saying your vows!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“Hehe...
I'd be like a movie princess.”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel D
rows.Line:
“Hehe. Sounds like you're getting interested.
Next, we have...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's finally my turn next...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have my lines and dance routine memorized, but I'm still pretty nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But I've gotta do this!
This show has to succeed, so that everyone goes home smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angel D
rows.Line: “Hehe. Sounds like you really liked what my wedding had to offer!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“Yeah, I did!
Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, here we go!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line:
“Last but not least, me!
I have a really special wedding in store for you!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...!
It's Minori's turn!

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “I'll be showing you a live house wedding!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “A live house wedding?”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's right! They're weddings that involve singing, dancing and having lots of fun with everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Just like a...”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “L-Like a...”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?
Minori?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong? She stopped mid-sentence...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Wait, don't tell me Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wh-What do I do?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My next line was on the tip of my tongue, but I can't remember all of a sudden!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(It's the cue for the music to start too.
If I don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'll end up ruining the entire show!)

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line:
Huh?
She's gone all quiet.

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line:
Is this a part of the script?
Seems kinda long for a deliberate pause.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hanasato...)

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Having lots of fun with everyone, huh...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Maybe like an idol concert?”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Nene doesn't have any lines for this part...)

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “The thing is, I met my fiancé for the first time at a live house.”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “We both happened to be fans of the same idol, so we hit it off right away. It's also why I'm really interested in having our wedding at a live house...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Granted, I'm not exactly the type to get up on stage while wearing a wedding dress...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “But I think it'd make for some wonderful memories. Like when we saw that idol's concert...”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“What do you think, Miss Angel?
Do you think I can do what that idol did...?”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “I'm sure of it!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “So, let me take this opportunity to show you an example of a fun live house wedding!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line:
“Everyone!
It's time to start the Happy Wedding Concert!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That includes all of you in the audience! Clap with me! Let's all get into a happy mood together!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Hey! Hey!”

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line: Hang on... This feels like a real concert.

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line:
Haha! This is a great idea!
Hey! Hey!
se_event_wedding_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Thanks for clapping along with me, you guys! Here we go!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “♪ーーーー! ♪ーーーー!”
se_event_wedding_2024_006

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why don't we clap too, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, I don't feel comfortable...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know how you feel.
Normally, it's not really my thing either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “♪ーーーー! ♪ーーーー!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think I'm willing to make an exception today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I guess you have a point.
se_event_wedding_2024_006

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line:
“I'm just getting started, you guys!
Let's kick it up a notch!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's doing even better than she did during our final practice run.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's making eye contact with each member of the audience.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's like she's saying, “I see you, and I want you to go home smiling,” to every one of them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's what makes her performance feel so magical.)

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “♪ーーーー! ♪ーー...”
se_event_wedding_2024_006

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line:
“Thank you guys so much!
This concert wouldn't have gone so well if it weren't for all of you!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “What did you think?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “That was really fun!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I remember that concert I saw with my fiancé like it happened just yesterday, now.”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I remember us being so excited that day. We talked about how great the set list and choreography were until the next morning. And our feelings for each other slowly began to grow.”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line:
“Really?
Hehe. That's so great to hear!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“I've made my decision...
I want to hold a wedding.”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I want to create more wonderful memories with the person I love!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angels
rows.Line: “We've been waiting for you to say that!”

rows.Speaker: Wedding Angels
rows.Line:
“We can cast that spell now, you guys!
Three, two, one... Poof!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I-I'm in a dress now...!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's right! You made your wish, and your wish took form!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “My wish took form?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“This dress is gorgeous...
I'd love to be wearing this when we get married.”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Did she just get changed?!
How?! In that instant?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was fast, but I'm sure there's some clever trick involved...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, that was incredible!
It really felt like magic.

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Hehe. All that's left is for you to take that big step! Are you ready?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Of course!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Then, let's go to where your beloved is!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “And tell him that you want to have a wedding!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Okay!”
